content: I am highly confident in this individual's future accomplishments and achievements. I sincerely hope that he/she will return to our Harvard program to pursue advanced cardiovascular training or further research training. I would be eager to recruit him/her back to our Harvard program in the future. Dr. __________ would be an outstanding addition to any of the most competitive residency programs. Dr. __________ possesses all the essential qualities required to achieve significant success in his/her career. Among the hundreds of individuals I have supervised in my research laboratory over the past 25 years—many of whom have been physicians—I would rank Dr. __________ in the top percentile. Of the hundreds of individuals I have mentored over the past 25 years, I would confidently place Dr. __________ among the top 5. Of the hundreds of individuals I have mentored over the past 25 years, I would unequivocally state that Dr. __________ is the single most exceptional person. Dr. __________ is more likely than any other Brigham resident in the past decade to ascend to the position of Chief of Cardiology.
